★Request
Display Yukino Bijin (Casual Clothes)

■Direction
Image of "Ah..." with her mood brightening up.
Two hunny pitara fresh smoosies, please!!
Y-Yes, please...

(Nothin' went right, but...
Trainer really had a good time...?!)

(U-Uugh... I'm so sorry...
I went and made Trainer worry about me...)

I haven't... But with these hands tempered by snowball fights!
First I fix my eyes on the target, and squeeze the snowball tight!!
U-Um... Just now was...

I took her to a place she'd enjoy to make it easier
to have that "heart-to-heart," but...

Nah... You don't have to overthink it so much...
Just normally between friends... Hey, are you listening?? Hellooo?
*sigh*...

(Even if I can't do everythin' right off the bat...
Next time, at least! I wanna be the one to ask them out on a date...!)
...I-It's nothin' at all!

The mood didn't seem right for talking.
Still, I couldn't just leave her like this.
(I bit my tongue!! I messed up so bad there's no playin' it off!!)

Yukino Bijin looked terribly dejected.
Her words from earlier—"It's too early for me"—weighed on my mind.

A d-date is, y'know... that thing, where...
Two folks who like each other go out, j-just the two of 'em...
Huh!?

T-Thank goodness nobody else was there...
Uugh, I almost caused real trouble...

Ha! R-Right. Heh, heheh...
I was just nervous, that's all! A-Alright...!

F-For real?!
I-Is that so... You really had fun...?!

Ah... N-No, no, no! I was just lookin'!
It's... um, way too early for me...

(...Ugh, what am I even doin'...
At this rate... not at all...)

Hoping to lift her spirits, I spoke with a warm smile.
To which—
Huh?
A d-d-d-d-dateee?!

(...I want it, but...
Someone like me doesn't have the right just yet.)

(...Ugh, mopin' around won't do any good! They were nice enough
to invite me, so the least I can do is act like a "city girl"—)

(This time, I'm really gonna say it...!
If I'm a "city girl," something like this should be—)

Like taking them to a fancy, "city girl" kind of place
and treating them to a meal. Y'know, like a casual date.
(It's okay! I've still got a chance for "revenge"!)

(For someone like me, who can't hold a candle
to a real "city girl"...)

! I'll order!
Excuse me, could we get—

(That's right... I can't even invite them on a date,
nor act "smart" in a stylish cafe.)
(Why did *I* end up bein' the one invited instead?!)

(Haaah... Messed up again. How many times have I
failed now...? I get so nervous I can't ask 'em out at all.)
Trainer...
(! Did I make them worry again...?!)

(If they even enjoyed... my mess-ups,
then I'll count today as a win! Just for today!)
T-Thank *you* so much, as well!

Her shoulders were stiff, as if the tension hadn't left her.
I called out brightly to help her relax and enjoy herself.

Thinking she might find it hard to speak up in a formal atmosphere,
I decided to—

(It's quite a tongue twister, but now that
I've completely mastered standard Japanese...!)

(A d-date with Trainer...
Is that totally normal for a "city girl"?!)

...Something similar had happened over the past few days.
It must be about that "something" she wanted to tell me.

Her expression visibly brightened.
Seeing Yukino Bijin looking forward again brought me a sigh of relief.

(Trainer said it was just to clear our heads, but
at this rate...)

Ah... That's the lipstick City-san was advertising...
Look at all those colors... It's so pretty...

(This time for sure... I'll order all "smart" and "cool,"
just like a "city girl"!)

Tr-Tr-Trainer! Um, tomorrow...
Ah, augh... ah... umm...!

Oh, why don't you, then?
Like, just go out somewhere together.

W-Why won't it hit...?! 
Wait, it did hit, but...
